R1.evidence: Gateway cold-boots healthy in ~54s (amd64 emulated) and serves the corpus over the real AWS API, but no tests/test.sh entrypoint and no solution/solve.sh exist anywhere in the repo — nop/oracle (R1.3) is unmeasurable. Clone ships as a reusable sidecar, not a bundled Harbor task.

R2.evidence: Runtime canon gates a,c,d,e,g pass (verified: leak-clean python:slim agent, mount-not-copy data, token-gated operator boundary). But b/j fail: no :prod-v1/:empty trio (imagetools inspect :prod-v1 -> not found), corpus not baked into any image (no COPY <corpus> -> DB). k fails: GHCR image is single-arch linux/amd64 (arm64 pull -> 'no matching manifest for linux/arm64/v8'; CI declares no platforms:).

R3.evidence: No MCP server ships. Exhaustive `grep -ril mcp` over the repo returns no matches. Agent operates only the real CLI (aws/awslocal) plus operator-only aws-clonectl. The named 'both CLI + MCP in parity' goal is unmet.

R4.evidence: Real AWS surface is well-covered and envelope-faithful (live: real SQS QueueUrls, DynamoDB typed items, ResourceNotFoundException). But docs/COVERAGE.md is absent (R4.1) — no machine-checkable matrix; and every row lacks an MCP mapping (R4.2).

R5.evidence: Verified live: DynamoDB write->read round-trip (put-item -> get-item returns 'done'); realistic typed error (ResourceNotFoundException, not 500); query grammar via --query and logs --filter-pattern; IAM shim devops shape (simulate-custom-policy -> allowed, computed from live policy state). >=6 assessment-grade capabilities; round-trip exercised.

R6.evidence: 34/34 pytest pass from a clean py3.13 venv (seed rendering, IAM policy engine, credential report, admin auth, state schema, CLI/admin parity vs in-process server). But no MCP tests (none can exist), no in-agent isolation test asserting import aws_clone.seed raises, and AWS endpoint/CLI coverage is compose-smoke not per-capability happy+error.
